highlights: On your network. Turn on Share on local network and give each client a named gateway key, each with its own daily, weekly or monthly token and cost limit.
Docker. Run ghcr.io/yetone/magpie on a server or a NAS and manage it from the web UI.
Balances and quota windows for every key, plan and subscription account (magpie quota).
GitHub Copilot, Gemini (Code Assist), Antigravity, Grok (SuperGrok) and more

Codex / ChatGPT：你的 ChatGPT 订阅里的模型，给所有其他 Agent 用
